author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: THIS book is concerned with the art of realizing your desire. It gives you an account of the mechanism used in the production of the visible world. It is a small book but not slight. There is a treasure in it, a clearly defined road to the realization of your dreams.
context_after: Were it possible to carry conviction to another by means of reasoned arguments and detailed instances, this book would be many times its size.
selection_note: Классическое авторское предисловие, раскрывающее практическую цель книги.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Personal success will prove far more convincing than all the books that could be written on the subject.
context_before: Consequently, I have purposely omitted all arguments and testimonials and simply challenge the open-minded reader to practice the law of consciousness as revealed in this book.
context_after: – NEVILLE
selection_note: Яркий афоризм о превосходстве личного опыта над теоретическими доказательствами.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: THE world, and all within it, is man’s conditioned consciousness objectified. Consciousness is the cause as well as the substance of the entire world. So it is to consciousness that we must turn if we would discover the secret of creation.
context_after: Knowledge of the law of consciousness and the method of operating this law will enable you to accomplish all you desire in life.
selection_note: Фундаментальный тезис метафизики Невилла Годдарда о сознании как причине и субстанции бытия.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Knowledge of the law of consciousness and the method of operating this law will enable you to accomplish all you desire in life. Armed with a working knowledge of this law, you can build and maintain an ideal world.
context_before: THE world, and all within it, is man’s conditioned consciousness objectified. Consciousness is the cause as well as the substance of the entire world. So it is to consciousness that we must turn if we would discover the secret of creation.
context_after: Consciousness is the one and only reality, not figuratively but actually.
selection_note: Практическое обещание закона сознания: возможность построить и поддерживать идеальный мир.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Consciousness is the one and only reality, not figuratively but actually.
context_before: Armed with a working knowledge of this law, you can build and maintain an ideal world.
context_after: This reality may for the sake of clarity be likened unto a stream which is divided into two parts, the conscious and the subconscious.
selection_note: Лаконичная и бескомпромиссная аксиома о буквальной реальности сознания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The conscious is personal and selective; the subconscious is impersonal and non-selective. The conscious is the realm of effect; the subconscious is the realm of cause.
context_before: In order to intelligently operate the law of consciousness, it is necessary to understand the relationship between the conscious and the subconscious.
context_after: These two aspects are the male and female divisions of consciousness. The conscious is male; the subconscious is female.
selection_note: Четкое разграничение функций сознательного и подсознательного уровней ума.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The conscious generates ideas and impresses these ideas on the subconscious; the subconscious receives ideas and gives form and expression to them.
context_before: These two aspects are the male and female divisions of consciousness. The conscious is male; the subconscious is female.
context_after: By this law — first conceiving an idea and then impressing the idea conceived on the subconscious — all things evolve out of consciousness; and without this sequence, there is not anything made that is made.
selection_note: Базовый алгоритм материализации: генерация идеи, ее запечатление и последующее воплощение.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: By this law — first conceiving an idea and then impressing the idea conceived on the subconscious — all things evolve out of consciousness; and without this sequence, there is not anything made that is made.
context_before: The conscious generates ideas and impresses these ideas on the subconscious; the subconscious receives ideas and gives form and expression to them.
context_after: The conscious impresses the subconscious, while the subconscious expresses all that is impressed upon it.
selection_note: Обобщение универсального созидательного закона со ссылкой на Ин 1:3.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The conscious impresses the subconscious, while the subconscious expresses all that is impressed upon it.
context_before: By this law — first conceiving an idea and then impressing the idea conceived on the subconscious — all things evolve out of consciousness; and without this sequence, there is not anything made that is made.
context_after: The subconscious does not originate ideas, but accepts as true those which the conscious mind feels to be true and — in a way known only to itself — objectifies the accepted ideas.
selection_note: Предельно четкая и ритмичная формулировка механизма 'впечатление — выражение'.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The subconscious does not originate ideas, but accepts as true those which the conscious mind feels to be true and — in a way known only to itself — objectifies the accepted ideas.
context_before: The conscious impresses the subconscious, while the subconscious expresses all that is impressed upon it.
context_after: Therefore, through his power to imagine and feel and his freedom to choose the idea he will entertain, man has control over creation.
selection_note: Подсознание принимает как истину то, что сознание ощущает истинным, и объективирует это.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Therefore, through his power to imagine and feel and his freedom to choose the idea he will entertain, man has control over creation. Control of the subconscious is accomplished through control of your ideas and feelings.
context_before: The subconscious does not originate ideas, but accepts as true those which the conscious mind feels to be true and — in a way known only to itself — objectifies the accepted ideas.
context_after: The mechanism of creation is hidden in the very depth of the subconscious, the female aspect or womb of creation.
selection_note: Власть человека над творением строится на способности выбирать идеи и управлять чувствами.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The subconscious transcends reason and is independent of induction. It contemplates a feeling as a fact existing within itself and on this assumption proceeds to give expression to it.
context_before: The mechanism of creation is hidden in the very depth of the subconscious, the female aspect or womb of creation.
context_after: The creative process begins with an idea and its cycle runs its course as a feeling and ends in a volition to act.
selection_note: Подсознание стоит выше логики и воспринимает принятое чувство как факт внутренней реальности.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The creative process begins with an idea and its cycle runs its course as a feeling and ends in a volition to act.
context_before: It contemplates a feeling as a fact existing within itself and on this assumption proceeds to give expression to it.
context_after: Ideas are impressed on the subconscious through the medium of feeling.
selection_note: Краткая и стройная схема созидательного цикла от идеи через чувство к действию.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Ideas are impressed on the subconscious through the medium of feeling.
context_before: The creative process begins with an idea and its cycle runs its course as a feeling and ends in a volition to act.
context_after: No idea can be impressed on the subconscious until it is felt, but once felt — be it good, bad or indifferent — it must be expressed.
selection_note: Главный лейтмотив книги: чувство как единственный проводник идей в подсознание.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: No idea can be impressed on the subconscious until it is felt, but once felt — be it good, bad or indifferent — it must be expressed. Feeling is the one and only medium through which ideas are conveyed to the subconscious.
context_before: Ideas are impressed on the subconscious through the medium of feeling.
context_after: Therefore, the man who does not control his feeling may easily impress the subconscious with undesirable states.
selection_note: Развернутое обоснование неизбежности выражения любого прочувствованного состояния.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: By control of feeling is not meant restraint or suppression of your feeling, but rather the disciplining of self to imagine and entertain only such feeling as contributes to your happiness.
context_before: Therefore, the man who does not control his feeling may easily impress the subconscious with undesirable states.
context_after: Control of your feeling is all important to a full and happy life.
selection_note: Принципиальное различие между подавлением эмоций и сознательной культивацией созидательных состояний.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Control of your feeling is all important to a full and happy life. Never entertain an undesirable feeling, nor think sympathetically about wrong in any shape or form. Do not dwell on the imperfection of yourself or others.
context_before: By control of feeling is not meant restraint or suppression of your feeling, but rather the disciplining of self to imagine and entertain only such feeling as contributes to your happiness.
context_after: To do so is to impress the subconscious with these limitations.
selection_note: Заповедь ментальной чистоты: отказ от фиксации на несовершенствах себя и других.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: What you do not want done unto you, do not feel that it is done unto you or another. This is the whole law of a full and happy life. Everything else is commentary.
context_before: Do not dwell on the imperfection of yourself or others. To do so is to impress the subconscious with these limitations.
context_after: Every feeling makes a subconscious impression and, unless it is counteracted by a more powerful feeling of an opposite nature, must be expressed.
selection_note: Психологическое прочтение золотого правила: не допускать чувства зла по отношению к себе и другим.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Every feeling makes a subconscious impression and, unless it is counteracted by a more powerful feeling of an opposite nature, must be expressed. The dominant of two feelings is the one expressed.
context_before: What you do not want done unto you, do not feel that it is done unto you or another. This is the whole law of a full and happy life. Everything else is commentary.
context_after: “I am healthy” is a stronger feeling than “I will be healthy.”
selection_note: Закон доминирующего чувства: подсознание реализует эмоционально сильнейшее состояние.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: “I am healthy” is a stronger feeling than “I will be healthy.” To feel “I will be” is to confess “I am not”; “I am” is stronger than “I am not.”
context_before: The dominant of two feelings is the one expressed.
context_after: What you feel you are always dominates what you feel you would like to be; therefore, to be realized, the wish must be felt as a state that is rather than a state that is not.
selection_note: Классическое объяснение силы настоящего времени 'Я Есмь' по сравнению с признанием нехватки в 'Я буду'.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: What you feel you are always dominates what you feel you would like to be; therefore, to be realized, the wish must be felt as a state that is rather than a state that is not.
context_before: “I am healthy” is a stronger feeling than “I will be healthy.” To feel “I will be” is to confess “I am not”; “I am” is stronger than “I am not.”
context_after: Sensation precedes manifestation and is the foundation upon which all manifestation rests.
selection_note: Актуальное самоощущение всегда побеждает желание: желание должно переживаться как уже существующее.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Sensation precedes manifestation and is the foundation upon which all manifestation rests. Be careful of your moods and feelings, for there is an unbroken connection between your feelings and your visible world.
context_before: What you feel you are always dominates what you feel you would like to be; therefore, to be realized, the wish must be felt as a state that is rather than a state that is not.
context_after: Your body is an emotional filter and bears the unmistakable marks of your prevalent emotions.
selection_note: Неразрывная связь между внутренними ощущениями и проявленным миром.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Your body is an emotional filter and bears the unmistakable marks of your prevalent emotions. Emotional disturbances — especially suppressed emotions — are the causes of all disease.
context_before: Be careful of your moods and feelings, for there is an unbroken connection between your feelings and your visible world.
context_after: To feel intensely about a wrong without voicing or expressing that feeling is the beginning of disease — dis-ease — in both body and environment.
selection_note: Психосоматическая концепция тела как эмоционального фильтра преобладающих состояний.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Think feelingly only of the state you desire to realize. Feeling the reality of the state sought and living and acting on that conviction is the way of all seeming miracles.
context_before: Do not entertain the feeling of regret or failure for frustration or detachment from your objective results in disease.
context_after: All changes of expression are brought about through a change of feeling. A change of feeling is a change of destiny.
selection_note: Жить и действовать из чувства реальности желаемого состояния — путь ко всем кажущимся чудесам.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: All changes of expression are brought about through a change of feeling. A change of feeling is a change of destiny.
context_before: Feeling the reality of the state sought and living and acting on that conviction is the way of all seeming miracles.
context_after: All creation occurs in the domain of the subconscious. What you must acquire, then, is a reflective control of the operation of the subconscious, that is, control of your ideas and feelings.
selection_note: Знаменитейший афоризм Невилла: изменение чувства неизбежно меняет судьбу.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Chance or accident is not responsible for the things that happen to you, nor is predestined fate the author of your fortune or misfortune. Your subconscious impressions determine the conditions of your world.
context_before: What you must acquire, then, is a reflective control of the operation of the subconscious, that is, control of your ideas and feelings.
context_after: The subconscious is not selective; it is impersonal and no respecter of persons.
selection_note: Отказ от веры в слепой случай и фатум: мир всецело определяется отпечатками в подсознании.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The subconscious is not concerned with the truth or falsity of your feeling. It always accepts as true that which you feel to be true. Feeling is the assent of the subconscious to the truth of that which is declared to be true.
context_before: The subconscious is not selective; it is impersonal and no respecter of persons.
context_after: Because of this quality of the subconscious there is nothing impossible to man. Whatever the mind of man can conceive and feel as true, the subconscious can and must objectify.
selection_note: Чувство как печать согласия подсознания с объявленной реальностью.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Whatever the mind of man can conceive and feel as true, the subconscious can and must objectify. Your feelings create the pattern from which your world is fashioned, and a change of feeling is a change of pattern.
context_before: Because of this quality of the subconscious there is nothing impossible to man.
context_after: The subconscious never fails to express that which has been impressed upon it.
selection_note: Чувство задает лекало, по которому строится внешняя реальность.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The subconscious never fails to express that which has been impressed upon it. The moment it receives an impression, it begins to work out the ways of its expression.
context_before: Your feelings create the pattern from which your world is fashioned, and a change of feeling is a change of pattern.
context_after: It accepts the feeling impressed upon it, your feeling, as a fact existing within itself and immediately sets about to produce in the outer or objective world the exact likeness of that feeling.
selection_note: Безотказность подсознания: принятое впечатление сразу начинает искать пути материального выражения.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To impress the subconscious with the desirable state, you must assume the feeling that would be yours had you already realized your wish. In defining your objective, you must be concerned only with the objective itself.
context_before: The subconscious never alters the accepted beliefs of man. It out-pictures them to the last detail whether or not they are beneficial.
context_after: The manner of expression or the difficulties involved are not to be considered by you.
selection_note: Принятие чувства осуществленного желания и сосредоточение исключительно на цели.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: In defining your objective, you must be concerned only with the objective itself. The manner of expression or the difficulties involved are not to be considered by you.
context_before: To impress the subconscious with the desirable state, you must assume the feeling that would be yours had you already realized your wish.
context_after: To think feelingly on any state impresses it on the subconscious. Therefore, if you dwell on difficulties, barriers or delay, the subconscious, by its very non-selective nature, accepts the feeling of difficulties and obstacles as your request and proceeds to produce them in your outer world.
selection_note: Не думать о путях реализации и трудностях — держать фокус только на конечной цели.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Therefore, if you dwell on difficulties, barriers or delay, the subconscious, by its very non-selective nature, accepts the feeling of difficulties and obstacles as your request and proceeds to produce them in your outer world.
context_before: In defining your objective, you must be concerned only with the objective itself. The manner of expression or the difficulties involved are not to be considered by you. To think feelingly on any state impresses it on the subconscious.
context_after: The subconscious is the womb of creation. It receives the idea unto itself through the feelings of man.
selection_note: Фокус на трудностях подсознание принимает как заказ и воплощает новые препятствия.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To feel a state as hopeless or impossible is to impress the subconscious with the idea of failure.
context_before: Hence the subconscious out-pictures the idea in the image and likeness of the feeling received.
context_after: Although the subconscious faithfully serves man, it must not be inferred that the relation is that of a servant to a master as was anciently conceived.
selection_note: Краткое и точное предупреждение о деструктивном действии чувства безнадежности.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Your desires are not subconsciously accepted until you assume the feeling of their reality, for only through feeling is an idea subconsciously accepted and only through this subconscious acceptance is it ever expressed.
context_before: So, by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of your objective, the subconscious is moved to build the exact likeness of your assumption.
context_after: It is easier to ascribe your feeling to events in the world than to admit that the conditions of the world reflect your feeling.
selection_note: Идея принимается подсознанием только через чувство, и лишь после этого выражается вовне.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: It is easier to ascribe your feeling to events in the world than to admit that the conditions of the world reflect your feeling. However, it is eternally true that the outside mirrors the inside.
context_before: Your desires are not subconsciously accepted until you assume the feeling of their reality, for only through feeling is an idea subconsciously accepted and only through this subconscious acceptance is it ever expressed.
context_after: “As within, so without.” “A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven”; and, “The kingdom of heaven is within you.”
selection_note: Внешний мир не формирует чувства, а лишь зеркально отражает внутреннее состояние.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Nothing comes from without; all things come from within — from the subconscious.
context_before: “A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven”; and, “The kingdom of heaven is within you.”
context_after: It is impossible for you to see other than the contents of your consciousness. Your world in its every detail is your consciousness objectified.
selection_note: Абсолютная внутренняя причинность: весь опыт исходит из глубин подсознания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: It is impossible for you to see other than the contents of your consciousness. Your world in its every detail is your consciousness objectified. Objective states bear witness of subconscious impressions.
context_before: Nothing comes from without; all things come from within — from the subconscious.
context_after: A change of impression results in a change of expression.
selection_note: Человек не способен воспринимать ничего, кроме объективированного содержимого своего сознания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: You are already that which you want to be, and your refusal to believe this is the only reason you do not see it.
context_before: The subconscious accepts as true that which you feel as true, and because creation is the result of subconscious impressions, you, by your feeling, determine creation.
context_after: To seek on the outside for that which you do not feel you are is to seek in vain, for we never find that which we want; we find only that which we are.
selection_note: Вы уже являетесь тем, кем хотите быть, и лишь отказ поверить в это скрывает проявление.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To seek on the outside for that which you do not feel you are is to seek in vain, for we never find that which we want; we find only that which we are.
context_before: You are already that which you want to be, and your refusal to believe this is the only reason you do not see it.
context_after: In short, you express and have only that which you are conscious of being or possessing.
selection_note: Мы находим во внешнем мире не то, чего жаждем, а только то, чем внутренне являемся.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Denying the evidence of the senses and appropriating the feeling of the wish fulfilled is the way to the realization of your desire.
context_before: In short, you express and have only that which you are conscious of being or possessing. “To him that hath it is given.”
context_after: Mastery of self-control of your thoughts and feelings is your highest achievement.
selection_note: Краткая квинтэссенция метода Невилла: отвержение чувств и присвоение состояния исполненного желания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Mastery of self-control of your thoughts and feelings is your highest achievement. However, until perfect self-control is attained, so that, in spite of appearances, you feel all that you want to feel, use sleep and prayer to aid you in realizing your desired states.
context_before: Denying the evidence of the senses and appropriating the feeling of the wish fulfilled is the way to the realization of your desire.
context_after: These are the two gateways into the subconscious.
selection_note: Самообладание в мыслях и чувствах как высшее достижение и введение к практике сна и молитвы.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: SLEEP, the life that occupies one-third of our stay on earth, is the natural door into the subconscious. So it is with sleep that we are now concerned. The conscious two-thirds of our life on earth is measured by the degree of consciousness we take into sleep.
context_after: Our understanding of and delight in what sleep has to bestow will cause us, night after night, to set out for it as though we were keeping an appointment with a lover.
selection_note: Качество бодрствующей жизни измеряется тем состоянием сознания, с которым мы погружаемся в сон.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Our understanding of and delight in what sleep has to bestow will cause us, night after night, to set out for it as though we were keeping an appointment with a lover.
context_before: The conscious two-thirds of our life on earth is measured by the degree of consciousness we take into sleep.
context_after: “In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed; then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction.”
selection_note: Поэтичное отношение ко сну как к долгожданному свиданию с возлюбленной-подсознанием.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The conditions and events of your life are your children produced from the molds of your subconscious impressions in sleep. They are made in the image and likeness of your innermost feeling; they may testify to you of whom you are.
context_before: The subconscious — unlike the woman of the world who marries her husband to change him — has no desire to change the conscious, or waking state, but loves it as it is and faithfully out-pictures its likeness in the outer world of form.
context_after: “As in heaven, so on earth.” As in the subconscious, so on earth. Whatever you have in consciousness as you go to sleep will be the measure of your effort in the waking day.
selection_note: События жизни рождаются из подсознательных отпечатков, оставленных во сне в точном соответствии с глубочайшими чувствами.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Nothing can hinder man from realizing his objective that is not hindered in his consciousness.
context_before: Whatever you have in consciousness as you go to sleep will be the measure of your effort in the waking day.
context_after: If you would realize your desire, you must feel the desire as already realized before you fall asleep.
selection_note: Ничто внешнее не способно помешать цели, если препятствие не создано в самом сознании.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: If you would realize your desire, you must feel the desire as already realized before you fall asleep.
context_before: Nothing can hinder man from realizing his objective that is not hindered in his consciousness.
context_after: You must be in the consciousness of being or having that which you want to be or to have before you drop off to sleep.
selection_note: Прямое практическое правило: чувствовать желание уже исполненным до засыпания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Once asleep, man has no freedom of choice. His entire slumber is dominated by his last waking concept of self. It follows, therefore, that he should always assume the feeling of accomplishment and satisfaction before he retires in sleep.
context_before: You must be in the consciousness of being or having that which you want to be or to have before you drop off to sleep.
context_after: “Come before me with singing and thanksgiving.” “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise.”
selection_note: Весь сон находится под властью последней концепции себя перед засыпанием; засыпать нужно в чувстве свершения.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Your mood prior to sleep defines your state of consciousness as you enter into the presence of your everlasting lover, the subconscious. She sees you exactly as you feel yourself to be.
context_before: “Come before me with singing and thanksgiving.” “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise.”
context_after: If, as you prepare for sleep, you assume and maintain the consciousness of success by feeling “I am successful,” you must be successful.
selection_note: Подсознание видит вас в точности таким, каким вы сами себя ощущаете при отходе ко сну.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: If, as you prepare for sleep, you assume and maintain the consciousness of success by feeling “I am successful,” you must be successful.
context_before: She sees you exactly as you feel yourself to be.
context_after: Lie flat on your back with your head on a level with your body. Feel as you would were you in possession of your wish and quietly relax into unconsciousness.
selection_note: Непреложный закон: засыпая в состоянии 'Я успешен', вы неизбежно обретаете успех.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Sleep conceals the creative act, while the objective world reveals it. In sleep, man impresses the subconscious with his conception of himself.
context_before: The subconscious never sleeps. Sleep is the door through which the conscious, waking mind passes to be creatively joined to the subconscious.
context_after: What more beautiful description of this romance of the conscious and subconscious is there than that told in the “Song of Solomon”
selection_note: Сон — время сокровенного запечатления Я-концепции, а мир бодрствования — ее обнародование.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Night after night, you should assume the feeling of being, having, and witnessing that which you seek to be, possess, and see manifested. Never go to sleep feeling discouraged or dissatisfied. Never sleep in the consciousness of failure.
context_before: Feel yourself in the state of the realized wish and quietly drop off to sleep.
context_after: Your subconscious, whose natural state is sleep, sees you as you believe yourself to be, and whether it be good, bad or indifferent, the subconscious will faithfully out-picture your belief.
selection_note: Золотое наставление: никогда не ложиться спать в унынии, неудовлетворенности или чувстве провала.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To assume the feeling of satisfaction is to call conditions into being which will mirror satisfaction.
context_before: Disregard appearances and feel that things are as you wish them to be, for “He calleth things that are not seen as though they were, and the unseen becomes seen.”
context_after: “Signs follow, they do not precede.” The proof of what you are will follow the consciousness of what you are, not precede it.
selection_note: Принятие чувства удовлетворенности материализует обстоятельства, отражающие это состояние.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: “Signs follow, they do not precede.” The proof of what you are will follow the consciousness of what you are, not precede it.
context_before: To assume the feeling of satisfaction is to call conditions into being which will mirror satisfaction.
context_after: You are an eternal dreamer dreaming non-eternal dreams. Your dreams take form as you assume the feeling of their reality.
selection_note: Знаки и вещественные подтверждения всегда идут вслед за состоянием сознания, а не впереди него.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: You are an eternal dreamer dreaming non-eternal dreams. Your dreams take form as you assume the feeling of their reality.
context_before: The proof of what you are will follow the consciousness of what you are, not precede it.
context_after: Do not limit yourself to the past. Knowing that nothing is impossible to consciousness, begin to imagine states beyond the experiences of the past.
selection_note: Мистический образ вечного сновидца, чьи мечтания материализуются через принятие их реальности.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Do not limit yourself to the past. Knowing that nothing is impossible to consciousness, begin to imagine states beyond the experiences of the past.
context_before: You are an eternal dreamer dreaming non-eternal dreams. Your dreams take form as you assume the feeling of their reality.
context_after: Whatever the mind of man can imagine, man can realize.
selection_note: Преодоление ограничений прошлого: сознанию возможно все, выходите в воображении за рамки былого опыта.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Whatever the mind of man can imagine, man can realize. All objective (visible) states were first subjective (invisible) states, and you called them into visible existence by assuming the feeling of their reality.
context_before: Knowing that nothing is impossible to consciousness, begin to imagine states beyond the experiences of the past.
context_after: The creative process is: first conceiving, and then impressing the idea conceived on the subconscious. Always use the imaginative process rather than the process of effort.
selection_note: Все физические факты рождаются из невидимых субъективных состояний, оживленных чувством их реальности.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Always use the imaginative process rather than the process of effort.
context_before: The creative process is: first conceiving, and then impressing the idea conceived on the subconscious.
context_after: In your imagination, go right to the end of your desire, feeling the thrill of having accomplished it.
selection_note: Афористичный императив практики: опираться на силу воображения вместо мучительных усилий.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: In your imagination, go right to the end of your desire, feeling the thrill of having accomplished it.
context_before: Always use the imaginative process rather than the process of effort.
context_after: Sleep eases the way to accomplishment. The waking mind is full of doubts, fears and obstacles. Sleep silences the critical conscious mind and permits the subconscious to work untrammeled.
selection_note: Суть метода 'жизни в конце': перемещаться воображением прямо к финалу и переживать восторг свершения.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Sleep eases the way to accomplishment. The waking mind is full of doubts, fears and obstacles. Sleep silences the critical conscious mind and permits the subconscious to work untrammeled.
context_before: In your imagination, go right to the end of your desire, feeling the thrill of having accomplished it.
context_after: Think of your desire as a reality now. Live in the feeling that it is so, until the feeling of satisfaction fills your mind and you drift off to sleep.
selection_note: Сон устраняет критические барьеры бодрствующего ума и дает подсознанию действовать беспрепятственно.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Think of your desire as a reality now. Live in the feeling that it is so, until the feeling of satisfaction fills your mind and you drift off to sleep.
context_before: Sleep silences the critical conscious mind and permits the subconscious to work untrammeled.
context_after: Ideas enveloped in feeling are creative actions. Use your divine right wisely. Through your ability to think and feel, you have dominion over all creation.
selection_note: Удерживать чувство реальности желания прямо сейчас, пока ум не наполнится удовлетворением и не уснет.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Ideas enveloped in feeling are creative actions. Use your divine right wisely. Through your ability to think and feel, you have dominion over all creation.
context_before: Think of your desire as a reality now. Live in the feeling that it is so, until the feeling of satisfaction fills your mind and you drift off to sleep.
context_after: While you are awake, you are a gardener selecting seed for your garden, but “Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone; but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.”
selection_note: Мысли, облаченные в чувство, становятся созидательными актами, утверждающими власть над миром.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Your conception of yourself as you fall asleep is the seed you drop into the ground of the subconscious. Dropping off to sleep feeling satisfied and happy compels conditions and events to appear in your world which confirm these attitudes of mind.
context_before: While you are awake, you are a gardener selecting seed for your garden, but “Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone; but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.”
context_after: Sleep is the door into heaven. What you take in as a feeling you bring out as a condition, action, or object in space. So sleep in the feeling of the wish fulfilled.
selection_note: Семя Я-концепции, брошенное в подсознание при засыпании, принуждает внешний мир подтвердить его плодами.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Sleep is the door into heaven. What you take in as a feeling you bring out as a condition, action, or object in space. So sleep in the feeling of the wish fulfilled.
context_before: Dropping off to sleep feeling satisfied and happy compels conditions and events to appear in your world which confirm these attitudes of mind.
selection_note: Кульминационный манифест главы о сне: чувство, внесенное в сон, возвращается как объект в пространстве.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: PRAYER, like sleep, is also an entrance into the subconscious.
context_after: “When you pray, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret and your Father which is in secret shall reward you openly.”
selection_note: Четкое определение молитвы как входа в подсознание, подобного сну.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Prayer is an illusion of sleep which diminishes the impression of the outer world and renders the mind more receptive to suggestion from within. The mind in prayer is in a state of relaxation and receptivity akin to the feeling attained just before dropping off to sleep.
context_before: “When you pray, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret and your Father which is in secret shall reward you openly.”
context_after: Prayer is not so much what you ask for, as how you prepare for its reception.
selection_note: Глубокое описание состояния молитвы как искусственного сна, делающего ум восприимчивым к внутреннему внушению.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Prayer is not so much what you ask for, as how you prepare for its reception. “Whatsoever things ye desire, when ye pray believe that you have received them, and ye shall have them.” [Mark 11:24] The only condition required is that you believe that your prayers are already realized.
context_before: The mind in prayer is in a state of relaxation and receptivity akin to the feeling attained just before dropping off to sleep.
context_after: Your prayer must be answered if you assume the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of your objective.
selection_note: Суть молитвы заключается не в выпрашивании, а в подготовке сознания к принятию ответа как свершившегося факта.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Your prayer must be answered if you assume the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of your objective. The moment you accept the wish as an accomplished fact, the subconscious finds means for its realization.
context_before: The only condition required is that you believe that your prayers are already realized.
context_after: To pray successfully then, you must yield to the wish, that is, feel the wish fulfilled.
selection_note: Молитва гарантированно находит ответ, когда желание принимается за факт и подсознание мобилизует средства.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To pray successfully then, you must yield to the wish, that is, feel the wish fulfilled.
context_before: The moment you accept the wish as an accomplished fact, the subconscious finds means for its realization.
context_after: The perfectly disciplined man is always in tune with the wish as an accomplished fact.
selection_note: Кратчайшая практическая формула успешной молитвы: отдаться чувству исполненного желания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: The perfectly disciplined man is always in tune with the wish as an accomplished fact. He knows that consciousness is the one and only reality, that ideas and feelings are facts of consciousness and are as real as objects in space; therefore he never entertains a feeling which does not contribute to his happiness, for feelings are the causes of the actions and circumstances of his life.
context_before: To pray successfully then, you must yield to the wish, that is, feel the wish fulfilled.
context_after: On the other hand, the undisciplined man finds it difficult to believe that which is denied by the senses and usually accepts or rejects solely on appearances of the senses.
selection_note: Идеал ментальной дисциплины: чувства и идеи столь же материально реальны, как предметы в пространстве.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Whenever you are in the state of mind “I should like to, but I cannot,” the harder you try, the less you are able to yield to the wish. You never attract that which you want, but always attract that which you are conscious of being.
context_before: Because of this tendency to rely on the evidence of the senses, it is necessary to shut them out before starting to pray, before attempting to feel that which they deny.
context_after: Prayer is the art of assuming the feeling of being and having that which you want.
selection_note: Закон обратного усилия: чем сильнее внешние потуги при внутреннем неверии, тем дальше результат; притягивается лишь осознаваемая суть.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Prayer is the art of assuming the feeling of being and having that which you want.
context_before: You never attract that which you want, but always attract that which you are conscious of being.
context_after: When the senses confirm the absence of your wish, all conscious effort to counteract this suggestion is futile and tends to intensify the suggestion.
selection_note: Афористичное авторское определение: молитва есть искусство принятия чувства бытия и обладания желаемым.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: When the senses confirm the absence of your wish, all conscious effort to counteract this suggestion is futile and tends to intensify the suggestion.
context_before: Prayer is the art of assuming the feeling of being and having that which you want.
context_after: Prayer is the art of yielding to the wish and not the forcing of the wish. Whenever your feeling is in conflict with your wish, feeling will be the victor.
selection_note: Попытка бороться с очевидностью чувств лобовым напряжением воли лишь усиливает внушение отсутствия.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Prayer is the art of yielding to the wish and not the forcing of the wish. Whenever your feeling is in conflict with your wish, feeling will be the victor. The dominant feeling invariably expresses itself.
context_before: When the senses confirm the absence of your wish, all conscious effort to counteract this suggestion is futile and tends to intensify the suggestion.
context_after: Prayer must be without effort. In attempting to fix an attitude of mind which is denied by the senses, effort is fatal.
selection_note: Молитва — это согласие, а не принуждение; при противоречии между мыслью и чувством побеждает чувство.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Prayer must be without effort. In attempting to fix an attitude of mind which is denied by the senses, effort is fatal.
context_before: Whenever your feeling is in conflict with your wish, feeling will be the victor. The dominant feeling invariably expresses itself.
context_after: To yield successfully to the wish as an accomplished fact, you must create a passive state, a kind of reverie or meditative reflection similar to the feeling which precedes sleep.
selection_note: Главный закон успешной молитвы: отсутствие волевого напряжения, усилие здесь фатально.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: To yield successfully to the wish as an accomplished fact, you must create a passive state, a kind of reverie or meditative reflection similar to the feeling which precedes sleep. In such a relaxed state, the mind is turned from the objective world and easily senses the reality of a subjective state.
context_before: Prayer must be without effort. In attempting to fix an attitude of mind which is denied by the senses, effort is fatal.
context_after: It is a state in which you are conscious and quite able to move or open your eyes but have no desire to do so.
selection_note: Пошаговое описание входа в пассивное медитативное состояние предсна (SATS) для утверждения желания.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: When this passive state is reached, imagine that you have realized your wish — not how it was realized, but simply the wish fulfilled. Imagine in picture form what you desire to achieve in life; then feel yourself as having already achieved it.
context_before: You feel a pleasant, comfortable rest and not inclined to alter your position, although under other circumstances you would not be at all comfortable.
context_after: Thoughts produce tiny little speech movements which may be heard in the passive state of prayer as pronouncements from without.
selection_note: Точная техника визуализации: представлять в картинах финал и чувствовать себя уже достигшим цели.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: All you can possibly need or desire is already yours. You need no helper to give it to you; it is yours now. Call your desires into being by imagining and feeling your wish fulfilled.
context_before: All that is necessary is to create a passive state and feel the wish fulfilled.
context_after: As the end is accepted, you become totally indifferent as to possible failure, for acceptance of the end wills the means to that end.
selection_note: Все желаемое уже принадлежит вам прямо сейчас; призывайте его к бытию силой воображения и чувства.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: As the end is accepted, you become totally indifferent as to possible failure, for acceptance of the end wills the means to that end.
context_before: Call your desires into being by imagining and feeling your wish fulfilled.
context_after: When you emerge from the moment of prayer, it is as though you were shown the happy and successful end of a play although you were not shown how that end was achieved.
selection_note: Фундаментальный постулат Невилла: принятие конечного результата автоматически порождает средства его достижения.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: When you emerge from the moment of prayer, it is as though you were shown the happy and successful end of a play although you were not shown how that end was achieved. However, having witnessed the end, regardless of any anticlimactic sequence, you remain calm and secure in the knowledge that the end has been perfectly defined.
context_before: As the end is accepted, you become totally indifferent as to possible failure, for acceptance of the end wills the means to that end.
selection_note: Метафора увиденного финала пьесы: свидетель счастливого исхода сохраняет непоколебимый покой среди любых сложностей.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Get into the spirit of the state desired by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already the one you want to be. As you capture the feeling of the state sought, you are relieved of all effort to make it so, for it is already so.
context_before: “NOT by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” [Zechariah 4:6]
context_after: There is a definite feeling associated with every idea in the mind of man. Capture the feeling associated with your realized wish by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of the thing you desire, and your wish will objectify itself.
selection_note: Вхождение в дух желаемого состояния освобождает от напряжения: состояние уже свершилось.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: There is a definite feeling associated with every idea in the mind of man. Capture the feeling associated with your realized wish by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of the thing you desire, and your wish will objectify itself.
context_before: As you capture the feeling of the state sought, you are relieved of all effort to make it so, for it is already so.
context_after: Faith is feeling: “According to your faith [feeling] be it unto you.” [Matthew 9:29]
selection_note: У каждой идеи есть свое осязаемое чувство: уловите чувство обладания, и желание объективируется.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Faith is feeling: “According to your faith [feeling] be it unto you.” [Matthew 9:29]
context_before: Capture the feeling associated with your realized wish by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of the thing you desire, and your wish will objectify itself.
context_after: You never attract that which you want but always that which you are. As a man is, so does he see.
selection_note: Лаконичное толкование Писания: Вера есть Чувство ('По вере вашей да будет вам').

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: You never attract that which you want but always that which you are. As a man is, so does he see.
context_before: Faith is feeling: “According to your faith [feeling] be it unto you.”
context_after: “To him that hath it shall be given and to him that hath not it shall be taken away…” That which you feel yourself to be, you are; and you are given that which you are.
selection_note: Одна из величайших максим Невилла: человек привлекает не то, чего хочет, а то, чем он является.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: That which you feel yourself to be, you are; and you are given that which you are. So assume the feeling that would be yours were you already in possession of your wish, and your wish must be realized.
context_before: “To him that hath it shall be given and to him that hath not it shall be taken away…”
context_after: “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him.”
selection_note: Кем вы себя чувствуете, тем вы и являетесь; принятие чувства обладания делает воплощение неизбежным.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: You are that which you believe yourself to be.
context_before: “Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus, who being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God.”
context_after: Instead of believing in God or in Jesus — believe you are God or you are Jesus.
selection_note: Кристально чистая формула идентичности: человек есть то, во что он верит относительно себя.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Instead of believing in God or in Jesus — believe you are God or you are Jesus.
context_before: You are that which you believe yourself to be.
context_after: “He that believeth on Me, the works that I do shall he do also” [John 14:12] should be “He that believes as I believe, the works that I do shall he do also.”
selection_note: Радикальный мистический манифест Невилла: переход от веры в стороннего Бога к осознанию божественности 'Я Есмь'.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: Jesus found it not strange to do the works of God because He believed Himself to be God. “I and My Father are one.” [John 10:30] It is natural to do the works of the one you believe yourself to be. So live in the feeling of being the one you want to be and that you shall be.
context_before: “He that believeth on Me, the works that I do shall he do also” [John 14:12] should be “He that believes as I believe, the works that I do shall he do also.”
context_after: When a man believes in the value of the advice given him and applies it, he establishes within himself the reality of success.
selection_note: Деяния естественно вытекают из идентичности: живите в чувстве того, кем хотите быть, и вы станете им.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: First published 1944 in the United States; copyright not renewed.
quote_original: When a man believes in the value of the advice given him and applies it, he establishes within himself the reality of success.
context_before: So live in the feeling of being the one you want to be and that you shall be.
selection_note: Финальное напутствие всей книги: практическое применение учения утверждает реальность успеха.
